displayName: Free Shipping Per Product for WooCommerce

dataLocation.evidence: Plugin source 1.3.5 (class-free-shipping-per-product.php): configuration is the WooCommerce shipping class slug and a shipping-zone method instance in wp_options; no remote calls or vendor account.

dataPresence.note: The plugin does something only when products sit in the `free-shipping` shipping class AND a zone has its `free_shipping_per_product` method enabled. Either missing means no live data.

pitfalls.summary: Products in the `free-shipping` shipping class ship free when every cart item is in that class. Wix delivery rates are set per region, not per product, so this is pending until a target is chosen. VERIFIED IN PLUGIN SOURCE 1.3.5 (class-free-shipping-per-product.php, 2026-10-31): no product meta; the class slug and the zone method instance (wp_options) are the whole configuration.

quirks: Seen on a live store: class defined with 0 products and the zone method disabled; 18 historical orders used it and keep their shipping line with the orders.
